title: Planning a picnic
instructions: Üç arkadaş piknik planlıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; gün, yer ve kimin ne getireceğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Let's have a picnic this weekend!

script.speaker: sara
script.text: I work on Saturday morning. Sunday is better for me.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: OK, Sunday. Where shall we go?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: What about the park near the river? It's beautiful.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Yes, I love that park. What time?

script.speaker: mia
script.text: At twelve? We can have lunch there.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Perfect. I can bring sandwiches and some fruit.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: I'll bring drinks. Water and orange juice.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: And I'll make a chocolate cake!

script.speaker: mia
script.text: It's going to be sunny on Sunday. Don't forget your hat!

questions.prompt: Why can't they go on Saturday?

options: to the park near the river
questions.evidence: What about the park near the river?

questions.prompt: What is Sara going to bring?
questions.feedback: Sara içecek getirecek: su ve portakal suyu.
